name: Предусилитель Emotiva PT-2
descriptionHtml:
Предусилитель Emotiva PT-2 — Stereo preamplifier combining FM tuner, analogue line inputs, MM/MC phono stage, DAC, USB, S/PDIF and Bluetooth. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • 4 stereo line-level pairs; 1 switchable MM/MC phono pair; Home Theat
  • 1 coaxial S/PDIF, 2 optical Toslink, 1 USB DAC input; all up to 24-b
  • DAC: Analog Devices AD1955, 24/192 kHz
  • Bluetooth 5 with AptX, AptX HD and AAC; receiver up to 96 kHz
  • FM tuner: External antenna input; 15 station presets

Характеристики производителя

Analogue inputs: 4 stereo line-level pairs; 1 switchable MM/MC phono pair; Home Theater Bypass inputs · Digital inputs: 1 coaxial S/PDIF, 2 optical Toslink, 1 USB DAC input; all up to 24-bit/192 kHz · DAC: Analog Devices AD1955, 24/192 kHz · Bluetooth: Bluetooth 5 with AptX, AptX HD and AAC; receiver up to 96 kHz · FM tuner: External antenna input; 15 station presets · Main outputs: Stereo line-level main outputs, configurable full-range or bass-managed; bass-managed high-pass cutoff configurable 40–200 Hz.

Product page currently identifies the unit as temporarily unavailable/sold out.
shortHtml: Cтерео предусилитель. Фонокорректор ММ/МС, ЦАП, FM, Bluetooth. Габариты (ШхВхГ): 432 x 85,7 x 342 мм 432 x 102 x 342 мм (с опорами), масса: 5,4 кг.
